scope: One saved 80-point development screen, two existing modes. Source DC values are diagnostic interventions in reconstruction only; no image encode, new quality configuration, perceptual scoring, peer maps or holdout access.
decomposition: D=actual-correctedDC; A=correctedDC-reference; total squared error = DC energy + remainder energy + 2 cross. Raw reference is preconditioned source. Gaborish/EPF reference is original source XYB; remainder includes AC error and preconditioning/filter bias. Linear/sRGB/display references are source PNG values. Nonlinear stages use finite differences, not separately filtered error planes.
limits: Source DC uses the frozen paired writer transform and Float32 grid. Correcting DC is not an encodable candidate and implies neither a bitrate nor a perceptual gain. Norms, channels, grid boundaries and 32x32 windows are unweighted diagnostics, not SSIMULACRA2 or Butteraugli predictors. Existing native scores are reused only.
outcome: The saved predictor DC improvement survives display filtering. Its added rate is consistent with the adverse Butteraugli BD-rate tradeoff. Average display error misses 17 saved Butteraugli-max harms above 1%; no safe local predictor or encoder fix is established.

summary.limits: Energy changes pool equal-size samples within each reported cohort; coarse images can dominate the all-distance energy totals. Per-distance tables are the primary comparison. Native score changes are means of saved same-distance changes, not new BD-rates. Sign agreement is diagnostic only, not predictor qualification.

verification.scope: Focused diagnostic correctness. Four fixed screen cases verify source-derived DC against aligned nearest rounding, allowing only the explicit Float32 source capture bound. No encoder or perceptual scorer is invoked.

source.policy: Expose existing first-party input conversion only. Reuse attributed Gaborish and output dither ports. No new port, encoder execution or active source change.

archive.policy: Five first-party diagnostics. Existing attributed Gaborish and dither modules are imported without changes. No encoder entry point is invoked.

disposition.priorFailure: Two of ten admitted holdout SSIM guards failed, worst +11.2025994290% versus +8.05%; zero full-band BA3 admissions. No later promotion stages followed.
